Today we're launching Perplexity Frontier Research. The goal of Perplexity Frontier Research is to create a system that can perform autonomous research. The work will focus on multi-agent orchestration, reinforcement learning, continual learning, systems, and pre-training. We
items.title_zh: 今天我们推出 Perplexity Frontier Research。Perplexity Frontier Research 的目标是打造一个能够执行自主研究的系统。这项工作将聚焦于多智能体编排、强化学习、持续学习、系统以及预训练。我们

items.title: We’re rolling out Multiagent, a new effort level in Computer and teammates. A lead agent splits tasks across a team of agents using different frontier models. As they work, agents share findings with one another, with the lead agent combining everything into one answer.
items.title_zh: 我们正在推出 Multiagent，这是 Computer 和 teammates 中一种新的投入级别。一个主导智能体使用不同的前沿模型将任务分配给一个智能体团队。在工作过程中，智能体之间会相互共享发现，主导智能体则将所有内容整合成一个答案。

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now available in Perplexity Search and Computer. On our WANDR benchmark, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 0.783 at about $12.54 per task, up 0.095 from GPT-6 Astra. GPT-6.2 Sol hit 0.746 at about $2.65, up 0.065 from GPT-6.1 Sol.
items.title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 现已在 Perplexity Search 和 Computer 中提供。在我们的 WANDR 基准测试中，GPT-6.2 Astra 得分 0.783，每项任务成本约 12.54 美元，比 GPT-6 Astra 提升 0.095。GPT-6.2 Sol 得分 0.746，成本约 2.65 美元，比 GPT-6.1 Sol 提升 0.065。

items.title: On Terminal-Bench 4.1, we ran five frontier models alone, as two and four copies, and leading a mixed-model team of four. In Multiagent, each mixed-model team outperformed both the lead model and multiple copies. The mixed team led by Gemini 4 Carbon scored highest, at 0.727.
items.title_zh: 在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上，我们分别以单独、两份和四份副本的形式运行了五个前沿模型，并让一个混合模型四人团队担任主导。在 Multiagent 中，每个混合模型团队的表现都优于主导模型和多份副本。由 Gemini 4 Carbon 主导的混合团队得分最高，为 0.727。

items.title: Orchestrator API serves 45+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, as well as open-weight models. You can connect an existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK to a Perplexity API key and all models can be called with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages.
items.title_zh: Orchestrator API 提供来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI 的 45+ 个模型，以及开放权重模型。你可以将现有的 OpenAI 或 Anthropic SDK 连接到 Perplexity API 密钥，所有模型均可通过 OpenAI Chat Completions、Responses 和 Anthropic Messages 调用。

items.title: Teams of agents also complete tasks sooner. When testing teams on WANDR, Every team of four scored higher than its model alone, and three of the four finished sooner.
items.title_zh: 智能体团队也能更快完成任务。在 WANDR 上测试团队时，每个四人团队的得分都高于其单独模型，且四个团队中有三个完成得更快。
